title.en: Hydraulic motor names the sections; Diesel 60 and LZ-60 HBT60-13.132 keeps the printed cells
title.zh: 《液压电机》只提供章节，Diesel 60 and LZ-60 HBT60-13.132仍用已印格子

description.en: The Diesel 60 and LZ-60 HBT60-13.132 note follows the outline of Hydraulic motor. Diesel 60 Concrete Pump and LZ-60 Diesel Concrete Pump are two Xingtai pages that both print HBT60-13.132. Only LZ-60 prints delivery pipe inner diameter 100 / 125 mm. The engine kilowatts are 144 on Diesel 60 and 145 on LZ-60. Neither page prints a piston or seal size.
description.zh: Diesel 60 and LZ-60 HBT60-13.132这篇笔记顺着《液压电机》的大纲写。柴油60型混凝土泵和 LZ-60柴油混凝土泵是邢台的两张页面，都印了 HBT60-13.132。只有 LZ-60 印了输送管内径 100 / 125 mm。柴油60的发动机千瓦是 144，LZ-60 是 145。两页都没有印活塞或密封尺寸。

h1.en: How Hydraulic motor arranges a note that only repeats Diesel 60 and LZ-60 HBT60-13.132
h1.zh: 《液压电机》怎样安排一篇只重复Diesel 60 and LZ-60 HBT60-13.132的笔记

directAnswer.en: For Diesel 60 and LZ-60 HBT60-13.132, copy the printed fragments and ignore any urge to borrow a figure from Hydraulic motor. Hydraulic motor only lends its headings. Diesel 60 Concrete Pump and LZ-60 Diesel Concrete Pump are two Xingtai pages that both print HBT60-13.132. Only LZ-60 prints delivery pipe inner diameter 100 / 125 mm. The engine kilowatts are 144 on Diesel 60 and 145 on LZ-60. Neither page prints a piston or seal size.
directAnswer.zh: 写Diesel 60 and LZ-60 HBT60-13.132时，只抄已印片段，不要从来源页《液压电机》借数字。《液压电机》只出借标题。 柴油60型混凝土泵和 LZ-60柴油混凝土泵是邢台的两张页面，都印了 HBT60-13.132。只有 LZ-60 印了输送管内径 100 / 125 mm。柴油60的发动机千瓦是 144，LZ-60 是 145。两页都没有印活塞或密封尺寸。

heading.zh: 历史的 液压电动机

body.en: “History of hydraulic motors” is a heading on the crawled page, used here only as the section name. It does not create a measurement. Model Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132. Diesel engine 6105 / 144 kW. Output 35 m³/h. Maximum outlet pressure 30 MPa. Hopper 0.4 m³. Pumping distance 150 m / 350 m. Hydraulic pump Kawasaki double pump 100. Size 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm. Weight 3500 kg. Aggregate size is not printed. Delivery pipe diameter is not printed. Model LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132. Engine 6105 / 145 kW. Output 50 m³/h. Pumping pressure 35 MPa. Conveying distance 100 m. Delivery height 300 m. Aggregate 4 cm and below. Delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm. Size 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m. Weight 5500 kg. The 100 m cell is distance. The pipe cell is 100 / 125 mm. The heading stops there.
body.zh: “历史的 液压电动机”是抓到的那一页自己的章节名，这里只拿来当标题，不另造一个测量值。 型号 Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132。柴油机 6105 / 144 kW。输送量 35 m³/h。最大出口压力 30 MPa。料斗 0.4 m³。输送距离 150 m / 350 m。液压泵为川崎双泵 100。外形 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm。重量 3500 kg。骨料粒径没有印。输送管内径没有印。 型号 LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132。发动机 6105 / 145 kW。输送量 50 m³/h。泵送压力 35 MPa。输送距离 100 m。输送高度 300 m。骨料 4 cm 及以下。输送管 100 / 125 mm。外形 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m。重量 5500 kg。100 m 那一格是距离。管径格是 100 / 125 mm。 标题到此为止。

body.en: Where the source outline says “Types”, the catalogue fragment below is the fragment a buyer is allowed to copy. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Use 100 / 125 mm only with the LZ-60 page. For Diesel 60, leave the pipe diameter blank. The Kawasaki double pump 100 cell is not a published spare page. Diesel 60 Concrete Pump and LZ-60 Diesel Concrete Pump are two Xingtai pages that both print HBT60-13.132. Only LZ-60 prints delivery pipe inner diameter 100 / 125 mm. The engine kilowatts are 144 on Diesel 60 and 145 on LZ-60. Neither page prints a piston or seal size. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: 来源大纲写到“类型”时，下面这句才是买方可以照抄的目录原文。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 只有对照 LZ-60 那一页时才使用 100 / 125 mm。柴油60的管径留空。川崎双泵 100 那一格不是已公布的配件页。 柴油60型混凝土泵和 LZ-60柴油混凝土泵是邢台的两张页面，都印了 HBT60-13.132。只有 LZ-60 印了输送管内径 100 / 125 mm。柴油60的发动机千瓦是 144，LZ-60 是 145。两页都没有印活塞或密封尺寸。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

body.en: A reader who opens the source page will find “Braking”. This note keeps the heading and puts the printed fragment beneath it. No. Diesel 60 prints 6105 / 144 kW. LZ-60 prints 6105 / 145 kW. No. Aggregate size is a missing field on the Diesel 60 page. LZ-60 prints 4 cm and below. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: 打开来源页会看到“制动”。这篇笔记保留该标题，并把已印片段放在标题下面。 不是。柴油60印 6105 / 144 kW。LZ-60 印 6105 / 145 kW。 没有。骨料粒径在柴油60页面是缺字段。LZ-60 印的是 4 cm 及以下。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

body.en: Use “Uses” to see where this block sits in the source article. The purchasing sentence is the printed fragment, not the encyclopedia prose. No. Piston outer diameter is a missing field on both model pages. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_motor
body.zh: 用“用途”看这一节在来源文章中的位置。采购时要抄的是已印片段，不是百科正文。 没有。活塞外径在两张型号页上都是缺字段。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_motor

question.en: Why is Hydraulic motor not a source of extra ratings for Diesel 60 and LZ-60 HBT60-13.132?
question.zh: 为什么《液压电机》不能给Diesel 60 and LZ-60 HBT60-13.132增加额定值？

answer.en: No. Diesel 60 prints 6105 / 144 kW. LZ-60 prints 6105 / 145 kW. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 不是。柴油60印 6105 / 144 kW。LZ-60 印 6105 / 145 kW。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。

question.en: Can the outline heading “Braking” rename Diesel 60 and LZ-60 HBT60-13.132?
question.zh: 大纲标题“制动”可以改掉Diesel 60 and LZ-60 HBT60-13.132的名称吗？

answer.en: No. Aggregate size is a missing field on the Diesel 60 page. LZ-60 prints 4 cm and below. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 没有。骨料粒径在柴油60页面是缺字段。LZ-60 印的是 4 cm 及以下。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。

question.en: Does “Uses” on Hydraulic motor fill a blank on the Diesel 60 and LZ-60 HBT60-13.132 row?
question.zh: 《液压电机》上的“用途”会填上Diesel 60 and LZ-60 HBT60-13.132的空白格子吗？

answer.en: No. Piston outer diameter is a missing field on both model pages. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 没有。活塞外径在两张型号页上都是缺字段。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。
